notes: A fragment for review, in the format of $TII/pipeline/graph.json (tiicee/pipeline/graph.py). The loader ignores the keys 'notes' and 'note'.
watcher.env must set CDM_WORK_DIR (the baseline work directory) for e8-data and e10-folds, and the Hugging Face cache and token for the GPU stages.

GPU estimates: 24 s an optimizer step (E8's measured 25.6 h for 3,840 steps), up to 20 s a validation or rollout episode, five minutes to load the model per process (assumed). See tiicee/clinical/bench.py.
Resources follow the prior studies' jobs: training 4 CPUs and 40 GB (replication scripts/submit_slurm.py:60-67), evaluation 4 CPUs and 16 GB (tim scripts/submit_slurm.py:82).

No gate is written here. Before E8's training stages are added they need a gate on export/approved/bench-nemotron.json requiring sequences_identical and visits_identical (and reference.follows_plan, training.follows_plan) to be true; its rule file belongs in tii-cee/gates/.
Bound cluster paths resolved November 13, 2026 by name only (directory and file names listed, no contents read).

stages.note: E8 and E9 data: train.csv, val.csv and lab_test_mapping.csv copied unchanged from $CDM_WORK_DIR/prepared/. test.csv is never opened.
E10 folds: five fold directories over the 2,160 training-plus-validation admissions, seed 20261113 (fixed in tiicee/clinical/folds.py).

Resume mechanics on the real stack (D-CLIN-RESUME): one seed trained uninterrupted and in parts, then rolled out. Defaults: 60 training and 8 validation admissions, pause at step 90, with the reference. Five jobs.

E9's bench of the second backbone. Defaults: 110 training and 12 validation admissions, pause at step 150, no reference. Four jobs. It waits for bench-nemotron so the resume mechanics are known first; that is an ordering, not a condition on its result.
Launch check 7.4a, first half: the primary policy's unguarded validation rollout regenerated once with every prompt logged. Same checkpoint and seed as tim's val-a V0.
Launch check 7.4a, second half: the regenerated rollout is accepted only if its final answers match tim's stored val-a V0 outcomes on at least 99% of admissions. Counts only.
